BiblicalUsage: Burning fever is one of the curses of the broken covenant: terror, consumption, and the burning ague that shall consume the eyes, and the LORD smiting with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the fever here as covenant language, not medicine: disobedience has a body, and it burns.
